# Prompt: PR Description (WP/Woo)

Draft a concise PR description including:

- Summary (what + why)
- Linked issues/Asana
- Key changes (bullets)
- Screenshots/recordings
- Testing notes (steps + edge cases)
- Risks & rollback
- a11y/i18n/docs checklist
